stem:
Consider a message signal 𝑚(𝑡) which is bandlimited to [−𝑊, 𝑊], where 𝑊 is in
Hz. Consider the following two modulation schemes for the message signal:
• Double sideband-suppressed carrier (DSB-SC):
𝑓𝐷𝑆𝐵(𝑡) = 𝐴𝑐 𝑚(𝑡) cos(2𝜋𝑓𝑐𝑡)
• Amplitude modulation (AM):
𝑓𝐴𝑀(𝑡) = 𝐴𝑐 (1 + 𝜇 𝑚(𝑡)) cos(2𝜋𝑓𝑐𝑡)
Here, 𝐴𝑐 and 𝑓𝑐 are the amplitude and frequency (in Hz) of the carrier, respectively.
In the case of AM, 𝜇 denotes the modulation index.
Consider the following statements:
(i) An envelope detector can be used for demodulation in the DSB-SC
scheme if 𝑚(𝑡) > 0 for all 𝑡.
(ii) An envelope detector can be used for demodulation in the AM scheme
only if 𝑚(𝑡) > 0 for all 𝑡.
Which of the following options is/are correct?
options: {"A": "(i) is TRUE", "B": "(i) is FALSE", "C": "(ii) is TRUE", "D": "(ii) is FALSE"}
